messages.content: 你能給我標準差為10、樣本大小為50、樣本平均值為25的平均值95%信賴區間嗎？同樣的，你能為樣本大小為150的情況做同樣的事嗎？

function.name: confidence_interval_calculate
function.description: Calculate the confidence interval for a mean. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample.

confidence_level.description: The level of confidence. Default is 0.9. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute confidence intervals for mean with given sample std dev, sample size, sample mean, confidence level 95%. Use t-distribution? Usually for small sample sizes, use t distribution. But we can approximate with normal if sample size large. The question likely expects using t distribution. We have sample_std_dev=10, sample_size=50, sample_mean=25. Confidence level 95% => alpha=0.05. For t distribution with df=49. t critical value t_{0.975,49}. Let's approximate: t_{0.975,49} ~ 2.0096 (approx). Actually t_{0.975,49} ~ 2.0096. So margin = t * s / sqrt(n) = 2.0096 * 10 / sqrt(50). sqrt(50)=7.0711. So margin = 2.0096*10/7.0711 = 20.096/7.0711 ≈ 2.842. So CI: 25 ± 2.842 => [22.158, 27.842].

For n=150, df=149. t_{0.975,149} ~ 1.976 (approx). sqrt(150)=12.247. margin = 1.976*10/12.247 = 19.76/12.247 ≈ 1.613. So CI: 25 ± 1.613 => [23.387, 26.613].

Alternatively, if using normal z=1.96, margin = 1.96*10/sqrt(50)=1.96*10/7.071=19.6/7.071=2.772. So CI: [22.228, 27.772]. For n=150: margin=1.96*10/12.247=19.6/12.247=1.600. CI: [23.400, 26.600]. Slight difference.

The question: "你能給我標準差為10、樣本大小為50、樣本平均值為25的平均值95%信賴區間嗎？同樣的，你能為樣本大小為150的情況做同樣的事嗎？" They want the 95% CI. Likely use t distribution. Provide both results.

We can call the function confidence_interval_calculate. It expects sample_std_dev, sample_size, sample_mean, confidence_level optional. We'll call twice. Let's do that.
